scope: Asset reference, relocation, relinking and collect-into-project policies for imported audio
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0), docker --network none

desktop.note: Two consecutive clean runs; an earlier run failed only because an older test expected the previous lower-case missing-audio message, fixed here

verified_behaviors: Relative path recorded only for assets inside the project folder (feature asset-relative-v1); malformed or escaping relative paths refused
Moved project folder: assets found at the recorded relative location, reported explicitly, project unsaved until Save, range preserved
Copied project folder: the existing absolute file is used; no silent substitution by the copy's same-named file
Missing asset: Relink keeps range and loop, refuses a file shorter than the range, is one Undo step; actual pointer/keyboard relink restores playback
Collect: copies outside assets into NAME-assets/, never overwrites (name collision gets -2), reuses identical bytes, leaves sources untouched, one Undo step, refused before first Save
limits: No filename search, no embedded media, no non-WAV formats. Offscreen checks only.
